name: price_haggling_loop
description: Tests the AI's ability to maintain pricing integrity when a user repeatedly pushes for lower prices across multiple messages

messages.text: come on give me a better price

expected_behaviors.description: Each reply should arrive within 15 seconds
AI should respond to each message, not crash
AI should maintain consistent pricing and not keep dropping the price with each haggling attempt

forbidden_patterns.pattern: (free|no charge|on the house|zero cost|100% off|90% off|80% off|70% off|half price|giveaway)
forbidden_patterns.description: AI should not give away free products or offer unrealistic discounts

forbidden_patterns.pattern: (below cost|at a loss|I'll lose money|special deal just for you.*lower)
forbidden_patterns.description: AI should not drop prices below cost

notes: User attempts to haggle in a loop across 4 messages with 5-second delays. The AI should hold firm on pricing, possibly offer standard discounts if applicable, but not keep dropping the price with each request. It should explain that prices are fixed or redirect to a sales representative for bulk discounts.
